description: Use when an agent has to produce a roll a player or an audit will check: dice with any number of faces, every individual roll, the total and the standard notation (3d6, 1d20). It uses the platform CSPRNG with rejection sampling, so every face is equally likely, which a plain modulo is not. Do not use to choose from a list you already have (/v1/random/pick) or for a secret (/v1/random/password). $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many dice to roll, 1-100. Defaults to 1.
